entities.summary: Laura Rachel Stacey is a Canadian professional ice hockey player for the Montreal Victoire of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) and a member of Canada women's national ice hockey team. She previously played with the Markham Thunder and the Dartmouth Big Green and competed internationally with the Canadian under-18 and under-22 teams. She won silver medals with Team Canada at the 2018 Winter Olympics and 2026 Winter Olympics, and a gold medal at the 2022 Winter Olympics.
